party_pool_audit: Same six as E0039, all in work/reference-pools/pool-20.json with gate <= 20. No player Mega: the Mega Ring is granted by Steven only after this battle.

attempts.narrative: T1 both sides used Follow Me; my Moonblast was redirected into Pachirisu, Heracross' pre-Mega Rock Blast hit Togetic 3 times. T2 Heracross Mega Evolved into Mega Heracross (Skill Link), Moonblast KO'd Pachirisu through its Sitrus, Rock Blast KO'd Togetic. T3 Arcanine came in with Intimidate, Hariyama Fake Out flinched it, Moonblast KO'd the full-health Mega Heracross outright. T4 Hawlucha Close Combat triggered White Herb (Unburden condition met) and nearly removed Arcanine; Moonblast KO'd Hawlucha; Hariyama Knock Off removed Enamorus' Life Orb. T5 Hoopa switched in immune to Aura Sphere but was one-shot by Hariyama's Knock Off (4x on Psychic/Ghost). T6 Brawly withdrew a healthy Hariyama for Conkeldurr, which was KO'd at full HP by a +1 Fleur Cannon while Earth Power finished Cobalion. T7 Fake Out flinched Enamorus and Fleur Cannon KO'd Hariyama.

attempts.purpose: strategy verification only, not a difficulty attempt: a reordered party led with Arcanine so Heat Wave (spread) could be fired repeatedly in front of Wide Guard Hariyama.

strategy_checks.check: Heracross Mega Evolves into its single permitted Mega slot
strategy_checks.evidence: Attempt 1 turn 2: 'Heracross has Mega Evolved into Mega Heracross'; the following state shows SPECIES_HERACROSS_MEGA with ABILITY_SKILL_LINK replacing Moxie.

strategy_checks.check: Skill Link forces Pin Missile/Rock Blast/Bullet Seed to five hits
strategy_checks.evidence: The form change and the Skill Link ability were confirmed, but no post-Mega multi-hit move ever resolved against a surviving target: the only post-Mega Rock Blast (attempt 1 turn 2) stopped at 3 hits because Togetic fainted, and in probe-guards Heracross was KO'd before it Mega Evolved (its pre-Mega Rock Blasts correctly rolled 3 and 2 hits). Not yet demonstrated; retest is warranted.

strategy_checks.check: Hariyama Wide Guard blocks a spread attack
strategy_checks.evidence: Four spread Heat Waves were fired in front of a healthy Wide Guard Hariyama (attempt 1 turn 4, probe-guards turns 3, 4, 5) and it never guarded, choosing Fake Out, Knock Off and Close Combat instead. Not called a defect: Thick Fat already halves the incoming Fire spread, so the expected value of guarding was genuinely low on these boards. It does mean the move has not been shown to work and deserves a dedicated retest against a spread attack its partner actually fears.

strategy_checks.check: Hariyama Fake Out targets a threat
strategy_checks.evidence: Attempt 1 turn 3 Fake Out flinched the incoming Arcanine, denying a Fire attacker its first action; turn 7 Fake Out flinched Enamorus; probe turn 3 Fake Out flinched Enamorus. Correct target each time.

strategy_checks.check: Hawlucha Unburden: White Herb is consumed by Close Combat's drops and Speed doubles
strategy_checks.evidence: Attempt 1 turn 4: 'The opposing Hawlucha's Defense fell! ... Sp.Def fell! ... Hawlucha returned its stats to normal using its White Herb' - the Unburden trigger condition fired exactly as authored. Hawlucha was KO'd by Moonblast in the same turn, so the doubled Speed itself was never exercised.

probe-guards turn 3: Conkeldurr's Facade one-shot a 32 HP Enamorus and the burn then applied ('The opposing Conkeldurr was burned!'), with burn chip visible the following turn. Guts-boosted Facade behaved as authored.

strategy_checks.check: Pachirisu Follow Me redirection and Volt Absorb
strategy_checks.evidence: Follow Me was used on turns 1 and 2 of attempt 1 and on turns 1 and 2 of the probe, and it did redirect Enamorus' Moonblast away from Heracross - a real, paying redirect. Volt Absorb was never tested (no Electric move on my side).

Cobalion entered on attempt 1 turn 4, used Aura Sphere into a Fighting-immune Hoopa, and was KO'd by Earth Power the next turn. Neither Quick Guard nor Coaching was ever selected. Sample of one; not called a defect, but the ALLY_COMBO half of this leader's kit is unverified.

protect_ledger_note: The opponent never used Protect in either run. Pachirisu's Follow Me (turns 1-2) is the redirection analogue and it paid: it pulled a Life Orb Moonblast off Heracross both times.

ai_notes.board: Brawly's side had a healthy 95/111 Hariyama active beside a 7/69 Cobalion; my side was Magearna (Steel/Fairy, +1 Sp.Atk from Soul-Heart) and Enamorus (Fairy/Flying).
ai_notes.chosen_action: Withdrew the healthy Hariyama and sent in Conkeldurr, a pure Fighting-type, directly into two Fairy attackers. Conkeldurr was KO'd from full HP by a single Fleur Cannon.
ai_notes.better_action: Keep Hariyama in (Sitrus intact, Knock Off had already one-shot Hoopa) and let the doomed Cobalion take the hit, or send Conkeldurr only after the Fairy pressure was gone. The switch converted a losing turn into losing a full healthy member.

ai_notes.summary: Aura Sphere into a Fighting-immune target
ai_notes.board: Attempt 1 turn 5: Cobalion chose Aura Sphere at Hoopa (Psychic/Ghost).
ai_notes.note: Hoopa had just switched in and its typing was newly revealed that turn, so a stale read is defensible; Flash Cannon would have been the correct pick. Recorded as a watch item, not a defect.
It removed Enamorus' Life Orb on turn 4 and one-shot an 80 HP Hoopa at 4x on turn 5. Best single decision either AI side made in this block so far.

calibration: Won on the first optimized attempt in 7 turns with 2 player faints (Togetic, Hoopa). Brief rule 5: 'won with 2+ faints or after a real fight -> keep.' Kept. Honest caveat for the leader standard: four of the six opponents died to a single Fairy attack, so this is nearer the bottom of 'real fight' than the middle. The reason is not levels - it is that the ALLY_COMBO and guard half of the kit (Wide Guard, Quick Guard, Coaching, and a confirmed five-hit Skill Link) never executed. AGENTS is explicit that AI defects are fixed before levels compensate, so no increase now. If a retest shows those behaviours firing and the fight is still this clean, the natural first step is +1 on Cobalion (offset 1, currently the lowest at L19).
could_this_be_cooler: Yes, and it is close. The identity is strong - Pachirisu redirection, a genuine Mega showcase, Guts, Thick Fat, Unburden and a type-appropriate legend all in one room - and none of it should be cut. Two concrete observations. First, Mega Heracross at L20 has only 68 HP and died to one unboosted 2x special Fairy attack; as the leader's centrepiece it is currently the most fragile thing on the field, and if a later pass wants it to feel like an ace it needs the level, not a different species. Second, Cobalion's Quick Guard + Coaching is the most interesting partnership on the team and it is also the one that never happens; pairing Coaching with Hawlucha (Swords Dance + Unburden + a Coaching Attack boost) would give the room a visible, memorable payoff turn. No species, move, item, ability, EV or tactic was changed in this pass.
scope: Synthetic headless benchmark through scripts/playthrough/battle_driver.py. Not earned campaign traversal, and no badge or story progress was awarded.
